periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is angled approximately 45 to 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ellipsoidal/oval, with a visual height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.4:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the patch extending further toward the zygomatic region than the frontal region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-pinna gap is approximately equal to 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the superior boundary.
